maps.name: Hallowmere
maps.description: The first village on the old dragon's road, hundreds of years ago the king came from Varnfell's distant capital to raise an army of adventures to destroy the old dragon. The king, the villagers and the dragon disappeared from history. Hallowmere gradually lost touch with the kingdom and had to figure out how to defend it's people in a world that has grown bleaker and bleaker since the king vanished.
